review_dimensions: Root set derives from configured runtimes plus Docling; selected distribution lookup follows metadata precedence; no full-environment enumeration in v2.
PEP508 markers, declared extras and late-extra dependency cycles reach a fixed point; conflicting later constraints are checked after a node was already selected.
Selected active transitive version/declaration changes affect identity; inactive optional and unrelated packages do not.
Direct URLs are rejected only when activated; malformed or missing active metadata fails explicitly.
V1 inventory remains byte-for-byte algorithm compatible; v1 recipe does not claim v2; explicit schema/algorithm selection remains separate.
V2 recipe binds environment implementation, worker/orchestration/alignment, configuration, runtime versions, model artifacts and bounds. Worker request and response both bind schema/algorithm/hash.
Native/base and v1 import paths do not import packaging, Docling or Torch; tested with an import blocker in a fresh process.
Actual metadata worker CLI with duplicate PYTHONPATH returns exactly the same 104-node closure and fingerprint.

cleanup.child_processes: All spawned child subprocesses completed before bounded subprocess.run returned; tests emitted terminal JUnit. Windows CIM process inventory was unavailable to this sandbox and was not used as evidence.

limits: This review checks metadata/environment engineering only, not actual PDF content recall or summary quality. ROOT owns the real conversion/content acceptance.
The digest binds selected distribution metadata and versions, not arbitrary wheel contents/native libraries or all import shadowing.
This is not a general full-repository review; only the four stated source/test files and lightweight independent probes were reviewed.
